description: This file implements the PowerManager plugin for WPEFramework, managing power states, notifications, and plugin registration.

classes.name: PowerManager
classes.description: Main class implementing the power management plugin, handling initialization, deinitialization, notifications, and callbacks.

methods.name: PowerManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing internal members and logging startup.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, registers for notifications, and sets up power management interface.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, releases interfaces, and terminates connections.

methods.name: CallbackRevoked
methods.description: Handles revocation of notification interfaces and unregisters them.
